name: vis_male_head_transfer_function
purpose: Direct-volume-rendering transfer function (opacity/color control points) tuned to show the HEAD (skin/soft-tissue surface) instead of bone. Derived from vis_male_transfer_function.json's skull-only preset for the same dataset -- see that file's notes for the underlying histogram.
notes: Background/soft-tissue peak sits around 60-80; bone density climbs from ~90 up through the low 200s (same dataset as vis_male_transfer_function.json). Opacity ramps up starting in the soft-tissue range (from ~50) with a skin-tone color, instead of the skull preset's hard cutoff below 90 -- since soft tissue sits OUTSIDE bone along the viewing ray, giving it a moderate accumulated opacity is enough for the skin surface to occlude the bone beneath it without needing opacity=1.0 per voxel (which would look like a flat, unrealistic shell rather than skin).
